answer: Every claim must pass a random buyer callback. When a claim arrives, the Lantern desk picks two of the filer's past buyers at random from the Grove ledger and asks each to confirm the work was real and delivered, and the claim waits on the Reef shelf until both answers arrive within three days. A buyer who denies the work, or one the desk cannot reach at all, voids the claim and forfeits a 200-coin bond, so 1,000 fakes need 1,000 invented buyers plus 200,000 coins in bonds. One operator filed forty claims under forty names and watched the desk call buyers who had never heard of him.
